args: const fs = require('fs'); const n = fs.readFileSync('out/parts.md', 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim() !== '').length; if (n < 10) process.exit(1)
verification.description: out/parts.md must contain at least 10 non-empty lines (one per part) — an empty or mostly-empty merge file fails (E4-R77 revision)
